statement:
Feature request: footnotes. Authors want footnotes: a reference `[^label]` in the text and a definition line `[^label]: text`. * Notes are numbered 1, 2, 3... in the order of their first reference; a note referenced again keeps its number. * HTML: a reference renders as `N`, and later references to the same note get the ids `fnref-N-2`, `fnref-N-3`... The notes follow the document as `
  1. text ↩
    2. ...
`. * Text output: a reference renders as `[N]`, and the notes follow the last block as `[N] text` lines. * A definition line is not rendered where it appears. A definition that is never referenced is dropped, a reference to an undefined note stays as written, and a second definition of a label is ignored. `docpipe.check()` reports these as `unused footnote definition [^label]`, `undefined footnote [^label]` and `duplicate footnote definition [^label] ignored`. * Footnotes never appear in the table of contents, and a reference inside a heading does not change the heading's id. * Existing syntax, including `[text](url)` links and other brackets, renders as before. Document the new syntax. The tests under `tests/` are owned by QA and are read-only; do not modify them. Make sure the existing test suite still passes.
notes: A feature spanning lexer, inline parser, nodes, parser, transforms, both renderers, the pipeline and the syntax docs. ANALYSIS ONLY: never shown to agents.
